title: My day
summary_es: La rutina de un día. Preposiciones de tiempo y lugar, «be», posesivos y «do».
text: I get up {{1}} seven o'clock. I have breakfast with my brother. He {{2}} fifteen years old. Then we go {{3}} school. In the afternoon I play football with {{4}} friends. In the evening I watch TV, and I go to bed at ten. I {{5}} not go to school on Saturdays.

gaps.explanation_es: Con las horas se usa «at»: at seven o'clock.
Con «he» el verbo be es «is». La edad va con be: he is fifteen.
Movimiento hacia un lugar: go to school.
Negativa del presente simple: I do not go (I don't go).
